name: io.github.philpof102-svg/biii
description: Safe-to-pay & token-genuineness verdicts on Base. Fail-closed, non-custodial: is a token the genuine issuer's or a look-alike? is a wallet known-bad? Every verdict re-verifiable on-chain.

environmentVariables.name: BASE_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base RPC used to read the chain (verify payments, inspect contracts). Read-only. Defaults to the public https://mainnet.base.org.

environmentVariables.name: MAINSTREET_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional hosted reputation oracle for the advisory merchant read (till_vet_merchant). Absent, the LOCAL trust-core classifier + known-bad floor still return a verdict (fail-closed).

environmentVariables.name: BIII_LAWBOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional gitlawb/LAWBOR node for reputation composition. Absent, verdicts fall back to the local floor (fail-closed).
